atten3.ptxt: If the cylinder head has been replaced with a new one, the spark plug tubes must be installed to the cylinder head.

s2.ptxt: Apply adhesive 1324 to the area of the new spark plug tube shown in the illustration.
Using a wooden block and hammer, tap in the spark plug tube to the position shown in the illustration.

item.ptxt: Install the spark plug tube within 3 minutes after applying adhesive 1324.
After installing the spark plug tubes, do not fill with engine oil for at least 1 hours.
Do not deform the spark plug tube.

s2.ptxt: Using a plastic-faced hammer, tap in the ring pin to the position shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Install Plug NO.1 (w/ Head Straight Screw)

s2.ptxt: Using a 10 socket hexagon wrench, install 4 straight screw plugs No.1 with 4 new water hole gaskets.

s-1.ptxt: Install Plug NO.2 (w/ Head Straight Screw)

s2.ptxt: Using a 14 straight hexagon wrench, install the 2 straight screw plugs No.2 with 2 new screw plug gaskets.
Using E6 and E8 torx socket wrenches, install the stud bolts at the positions shown in the illustration.
Using a plastic-faced hammer, tap the straight pins into the cylinder head to the position shown in the illustration.
Install the valve spring seats to the cylinder head.

s-1.ptxt: Install Intake Valve Stem Oil Seal

s2.ptxt: Apply a light coat of engine oil to the lip of a new intake valve stem oil seal.

atten3.ptxt: Do not confuse the body identification colors of the valve stem oil seals.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, push in the intake valve stem oil seal onto the valve guide bush by hand as far as it will go.

atten3.ptxt: Do not install the oil seal at an angle.

s-1.ptxt: Install Exhaust Valve Stem Oil Seal

atten4.ptxt: Install it in the same way as the intake valve stem oil seal.

s2.ptxt: Apply sufficient engine oil to the locations shown in the illustration.
Place the exhaust valve, inner compression spring and valve spring retainer on the cylinder head.

atten3.ptxt: Install the parts in their original positions.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, install the valve spring retainer locks.
Using a plastic-faced hammer, lightly tap the valve stem tip to seat the compression spring.
Apply sufficient engine oil to the locations shown in the illustration.
Place the intake valve, inner compression spring and valve spring retainer on the cylinder head.

atten3.ptxt: Install the parts in their original positions.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, install the valve spring retainer locks.
Using a plastic-faced hammer, lightly tap the valve stem tip to seat the compression spring.
Apply engine oil to the valve stem tips and install the 24 valve stem caps.

atten3.ptxt: Install the parts in their original positions.
